headline: European Bond Yields and Oil Prices Fall Amid Market Uncertainty
summary: European government bond yields fell on Friday as market risk aversion boosted safe-haven assets, while oil prices retreated on expectations of abundant supply.
why: Government bond yields reflect benchmark borrowing rates across Europe, while crude oil sets basic energy input prices globally.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Crude oil traded lower due to growing supply expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: European bond yields and oil futures fell as equity market declines drove capital into sovereign debt.
